name: exportmate_backend/events
description: Every named event the backend's own code logs, except the per-request line (import.committed, report.created, gemini.failed, ...), by severity: activity and errors per feature.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE}" AND jsonPayload.message:* AND jsonPayload.logger=~"^app\\." AND jsonPayload.message!="request.completed"
